issues.description: getCategoryLabel contract weakened: silently invents labels via heuristics with no explicit mapping
issues.detail: Previously the ADT had an explicit CATEGORY_LABELS map (authoritative source of truth) with a fallback. The new implementation drops the map and relies entirely on heuristics (length<=3 => uppercase, version regex). Postcondition is weaker: 'IAM' is correct by coincidence, but 'unused' -> 'Unused' (was correct), and 'trustboundaries' -> 'Trustboundaries' (was 'Trust Boundaries' before). This is a silent regression of the label contract.

issues.description: CategoryId type and CATEGORY_IDS constant deleted without replacement, weakening type contract
issues.detail: The previous module exported CategoryId as a discriminated union of known IDs. Deleting it removes the compile-time contract that callers were relying on (or could rely on) to enumerate categories. The new module exports only a string->string function. Any subtype-of-string discipline is lost; callers now accept any string.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER invariant violated: two keys map to the same ordinal (4)
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 breaks the invariant that SEVERITY_ORDER is a bijection from severity name to rank. Any code that inverts the map, iterates entries, or sorts using these values will produce ambiguous ordering. The right fix is a canonicalization function (Info -> Informational) at the boundary, not duplicating the key.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart percentage semantics now overloaded: same field means two different things
issues.detail: item.percentage is used both as 'width of bar relative to max' (calculatedWidth) and 'value/total*100' (displayPercentage), with the same field substituting into both. The data type's contract for 'percentage' is now ambiguous. Split into two named fields (widthRatio, sharePercent) or document which semantics callers must satisfy.

issues.description: labelFormatter on FilterOption is a leaky abstraction for filter values
issues.detail: Adding an optional labelFormatter to FilterOption pushes display concerns into the filter ADT. Cleaner boundary: the filter holds {id, displayLabel} pairs (valueLabelMapping already exists for this) and the renderer is dumb. Mixing a formatter callback with an entity mapping creates two parallel mechanisms for the same responsibility.

issues.description: CategorySelector overloads selectedCategory='all' as a sentinel for null
issues.detail: The component's external contract is selectedCategory: string | null, but internally the empty/null state is encoded as the literal 'all'. If a real category ever had id 'all', the abstraction silently collapses. Define an explicit sentinel constant or use undefined-valued Select state; do not collide sentinel with the value domain.

review.summary: The PR's main abstraction concern is the new getCategoryLabel in lib/categories.ts: it replaces an explicit, authoritative ID->label map with heuristics, silently weakening the postcondition (e.g., 'trustboundaries' no longer becomes 'Trust Boundaries'). The deleted CategoryId union further erodes the type contract. SEVERITY_ORDER's invariant is also broken by duplicating ordinal 4 across two keys instead of canonicalizing at the boundary. Smaller boundary issues: HorizontalBarChart's 'percentage' field is overloaded with two semantics, FilterOption now carries display logic via labelFormatter, and CategorySelector collides its null-sentinel ('all') with the value domain. None block merge, but the contract regressions should be tightened before this lands.
